name: Drill: build a 3x3 cobblestone platform with a corner torch
context: Building practice. Needs 10 cobblestone (and a torch if you have one). Survival world, wherever the player is now; never assume coordinates, find things with mc_find_blocks. Never dig the block under your own feet or straight down; dig staircases or side tunnels. Avoid lava and deep water (mc_mine allowFluids only for sand/gravel at shores). Do not break blocks of player-built structures.

steps.name: have 10 cobblestone
steps.goal: You need 10 cobblestone. If you have fewer, mine stone with a pickaxe (mc_mine block=stone count=10 radius=32 mines the nearest exposed stone).

steps.name: build the platform
steps.goal: Pick flat open ground about 3 blocks from you (mc_terrain helps). Replace or cover a 3x3 area at floor level with cobblestone using mc_place for each of the 9 positions (stand outside the square; never place where you stand). If you have a torch, put it on one corner block (mc_place item=torch on top of it).
steps.verify: all 9 floor positions of the 3x3 square are cobblestone (mc_blocks on the 9 positions).
